_comment: Copy to igor.config.json (gitignored) and fill in real values.
_scope_note: Hostnames IGOR is allowed to hit. Empty = nothing sent. A request to any host not listed here is skipped, never fired. This is your out-of-scope seatbelt.
_delay_note: Seconds between requests. Don't set 0 against a live target.
_roles_note: Which session owns the objects (victim) and which tries to reach them (attacker). With PwnFox, map your container colors here, e.g. owner=red, attacker=blue.
_auth_note: Headers stripped from the captured request before each session's own auth is applied. Add any custom identity header your target uses.
